threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'the Kingsland Road' is a proper address instead of just that endless stretch of takeaways and traffic.
Last night on the 45, a bloke serenaded the whole bus with his phone karaoke—'Wonderwall' on repeat. Best entertainment I've had in ages!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Riding the 104 bus, I knew I was home when I overheard a kid passionately explaining the difference between Berghain and Sisyphos.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know those spontaneous techno parties in random warehouses? Only in Berlin can a full rave pop up at 2 AM in a former factory. No entry fee, just vibes.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell locals by their eye roll when someone asks for directions to the 'Mission Dolores' instead of just Dolores Park.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a dog doing its business on the Civic Center tracks yesterday while Muni idled. Only in SF would that make the news; true city life.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll into any bodega for a proper breakfast, but most locals grab a quick coffee and pastry at the counter instead.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still check the metro map like it’s a treasure map, while locals swipe through their phones without a second glance.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused about the 24-hour bus service and assume every train might actually run on time.
Caught a night bus last Saturday; a guy in a bright pink suit proposed to a tree at Windrush Square, convinced it was his soulmate. Classic Brixton!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw an old man arguing with a pigeon over a pretzel near the park, I knew this was home. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a spontaneous silent disco in a random park on a Tuesday afternoon. Just grab some headphones and dance! It's surreal.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they roll their eyes at tourists taking photos of the murals but light up when a local asks about their favorite taqueria.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a bus at Civic Center yesterday—driver stopped for ten minutes to let a tourist take selfies with their dog on the steps. Classic San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just take a Fanta to any park. Nope! You’ll get weird looks at places like plaça del Sol. Only locals know the unwritten rules.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at how the bus can't fit through the narrow streets—locals just know better than to try.
